submission.natural_language_explanation: This negative pole is a retrospective detector of a word-internal token piece: it fires when the current token carries no leading space, i.e. a fragment the tokenizer glued inside a word that is being spelled out piece by piece (md in Filmdrama, ap in mahaparinirvana, rom in retromastoid, os in chemosignals, op in immunopositive, ':' in Category:X, the digits inside 10.1126/science.1227037, single-character Greek/Arabic and byte-fallback pieces), plus the rarer case of a glued punctuation or whitespace token; it never fires on a space-prefixed alphabetic word standing alone (0 of 90,498 such positions in the layer's scan reached a quarter of max, while 255 of 40,610 no-leading-space fragments did). Strength is largest for a short, common piece that cannot end its word inside a long, rare or technical string (chemical, biological and botanical terms, identifiers, URLs, DOIs, wikitext templates), and drops to baseline when the same letters are written as separate words ('retro mastoid', 'chemo signals') or when the rare word happens to be a single token ('quokka', 'syzygy', 'zugzwang'), so it is a spelling-out/fragment detector rather than a rarity or surprisal detector.

abstract class Mustache_Test_SpecTestCase extends PHPUnit_Framework_TestCase
{
    protected static $mustache;

    public static function setUpBeforeClass()
    {
        self::$mustache = new Mustache_Engine;
    }

    protected static function loadTemplate($source, $partials)
    {
        self::$mustache->setPartials($partials);

        return self::$mustache->loadTemplate($source);
    }

    /**
     * Data provider for the mustache spec test.
     *
     * Loads YAML files from the spec and converts them to PHPisms.
     *
     * @param string $name
     *
     * @return array
     */
    protected function loadSpec($name)
    {
        $filename = dirname(__FILE__) . '/../../../vendor/spec/specs/' . $name . '.yml';
        if (!file_exists($filename)) {
            return array();
        }

        $data = array();
        $yaml = new sfYamlParser;
        $file = file_get_contents($filename);

        // @hack: pre-process the 'lambdas' spec so the Symfony YAML parser doesn't complain.
        if ($name === '~lambdas') {
            $file = str_replace(" !code\n", "\n", $file);
        }

        $spec = $yaml->parse($file);

        foreach ($spec['tests'] as $test) {
            $data[] = array(
                $test['name'] . ': ' . $test['desc'],
                $test['template'],
                isset($test['partials']) ? $test['partials'] : array(),
                $test['data'],
                $test['expected'],
            );
        }

        return $data;
    }
}

adversarial_test_results.detail: Wikitext template markup whose pipes, equals signs and glued title pieces carry no leading space, a paraphrase of the Category:X example.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The maintenance schedule for the spectrometer begins with a visual inspection of the optics and a check of the coolant level. After the instrument has warmed up for one hour, the operator should open the configuration file chemoluminescent_sensor_profile and confirm that the gain matches the value in the calibration log. If the reading drifts by more than two percent over the next ten minutes, stop the run and record the ambient temperature so that the service team can compare it with the previous baseline.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The feature deep inside a long passage: a rare compound identifier is spelled out in pieces after about eighty tokens of ordinary context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The surgeon described a retro approach and normal signals in the old assay and the notes say the meeting ended
adversarial_test_results.detail: The hypothesis's own control case: the compound letters stand as separate whole space-prefixed words (retro, signals), which it says drop to baseline.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The solution was heated and then filtered through paper before the final assay and the reading was stable over the whole afternoon

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The op art poster hung on the wall above the old sofa and the meeting ended after the report

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The misunderstanding was cleared up after the meeting ended and the team checked the final draft
adversarial_test_results.detail: A long common word that the tokenizer keeps as one space-prefixed token, so no fragment exists for the detector.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The IT team finished the audit twice before the server was checked by the office
adversarial_test_results.detail: The claimed token IT carries a leading space as a standalone word, the case the hypothesis says never fires.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The article lists the plants of North America and their host and the archive holds the photographs
adversarial_test_results.detail: The scan example's wiki topic without the colon-glued Category markup; every token has a leading space.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The paper appeared in the journal and the volume was checked twice by the team before the meeting
adversarial_test_results.detail: Publication vocabulary as whole space-prefixed words, with none of the glued digits of the DOI example.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: This function returns the wallet request context to the caller thread and the caller was checked twice
adversarial_test_results.detail: The code example's topic in plain prose where every word is a single space-prefixed token and nothing is glued.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The default constructor of the container class is trivial and fast and the test was stable
adversarial_test_results.detail: Computing vocabulary as whole space-prefixed words, the technical topic with no fragmentation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The Greek word for memory appears in the oldest poems and the team wrote the report
adversarial_test_results.detail: The language topic in plain English: no Greek script, no pieces, and every token has a leading space.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The N A S A archive holds the lunar photographs and the report was checked by the team
adversarial_test_results.detail: Single-character tokens N, A, S, A that carry leading spaces, unlike the glued single-character pieces the hypothesis lists.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The yacht drifted past the bank while the whole team checked the report and the notes say the test was stable
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uncommon vocabulary as whole space-prefixed tokens, testing that rarity alone does not fire the pole.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The poster and the poems were checked by the team before the meeting and the report was stable
adversarial_test_results.detail: The trigger letters os and oe sit inside space-prefixed whole words (poster, poems), not as separate glued tokens.

adversarial_test_results.detail: A medium-length sentence of common words only, testing that length and a technical setting alone do not fire the pole.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The maintenance schedule begins with a visual inspection of the optics and the coolant level in the lab
adversarial_test_results.detail: The long holdout's technical maintenance vocabulary as whole space-prefixed words, with no fragmented token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The service group wrote the report and the team checked the batch twice before the summer ended
adversarial_test_results.detail: Office vocabulary as whole space-prefixed words, a near-miss of the long passage's wording with nothing glued.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Before the worker starts the setup of the machine they should write down the heat of the room and check the level of the fluid and then wait for one hour until the parts have settled after which they may open the menu and compare the reading with the value that the service group wrote in the log last summer and if it moves by more than two percent they should stop the run and call the office before the next batch begins

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The instrument was checked and the temperature was stable over the whole afternoon in the lab
adversarial_test_results.detail: Technical instrument vocabulary as single space-prefixed words, with no piece the hypothesis could read as a fragment.
